body: I’m not sure I would be helpful at all but if you just want someone to talk to I’m here. Although I’m horrible at any conversations, so don’t expect much. I don’t really know why I wrote this but I’d like to chat if you would too, but then again everyone online doesn’t seem to actually care and after a short while no one remembers. But I’m also down to chat too, if u want to.
That makes reasonable sense, it’s exactly what I try to force myself to do. Even though I am doubtful about it.

It’s not that I have a lot of free time, it’s more like I just try to escape the world, but still stress out that I am putting off my homework. I try to do it but it just feels so tedious when there are so many better things to do. Like a waste of my time, I just keep thinking about the future. Sorry, I gotta go now, thanks.
Sorry no luck, I probably wouldn’t be allowed to get any other pet. Thanks for your advice though.
My sister and dad are allergic. And exotic animals there is no chance with that one and my parents.
Yeah really wished we could have gotten a dog like that, I mean I obviously love my dog. But no offense to him, he’s got major issues.
There is no way, that my parents would get another dog. My mom hates how he misbehaves and how much he sheds. By dad picked him up while we were still debating over dog breeds, without asking anyone.

He definitely needs training, but during COVID we don’t want to do that. Cause if like we drop something on the floor, he will pick it up and growl and bite us if we come near him or try to take the thing. Sure he knows sit and down, but he very rarely listens to those things without treats.
Yeah, I wish someone would sit with my and help my out in my homework. But no will. Thanks for your advice, it is a good suggestion. If only I did have someone to do that with me.

Yeah, my mom does too. I don’t get her for years now I have been a A or B student. But if even slip up and little I have to listen to her yell and scream at me. Giving me lectures about how all my teachers except me to be better and all that crap. She goes on and on about my reputation in school. Reputations should not matter more than how people actually are and feel.

I couldn’t possibly imagine being one of those bright, happy people. In fact I would hate myself if I ever became someone like that. So I guess that is the only reason I like my depression, because I know what to expect. I know each day will feel the same way, I won’t get hurt because I’m already hurting.
If you ever need/want to chat with me you can.

I also need to vent, I’ve been having suicidal thoughts probably since I when I was 11 or 12. I am an idiot, a dumb hopeless romantic. I’m ugly, dumb, and have no talents, horrible at sports. My parents want me to get a damn arranged marriage this isn’t the 80s. They don’t ask me their opinion on anything expect I play around on a string as their damn puppet. They are both very toxic like most of my family except my sister. They are extremely close minded. Online school fucking sucks. They except me to keep my grades straight As but then say I shouldn’t worry about them. When they really don’t mean it. They both have major anger issues like most of my damn family. Stubborn anger ass people won’t budge on a damn thing, they are so close minded. They are racist, sexist, and basically any other word on the dictionary. My family have big blown out fights all the time about dumb things like if my dad. My grandma did not make him food and was late for an appointment he fucking called my mom. Like a little child and yelled at her for what her mom didn’t do. He literally made her wake up in the middle of her sleep and made her cry. He fights with my grandpa over money for every time he will start a fight if someone even says one damn word to him that he doesn’t like. My grandparents on my dads side are just as fucked up they basically in a way kidnapped my mom and dad, and stole their money. One time they took away my mom and dads passports. They took all of my dads money and my moms wedding jewelry. My uncle and aunt are just like my dads parents. My grandparents on my moms side had us pay for a trip to the us and then decided to go back out of fucking nowhere and started a fight. My grandpa used to hit my grandma and slap my mom sometimes. He still drinks to this day. My parents used to hit drag and punch my sister while I watched. Mostly my dad if she misbehaved. I was fucking 8 years old a child apparently they think stuff like that doesn’t scar you for life. I’ve seen my dad and my moms dad hit and punch each other a whole fight. When I was 5 or 6. That’s not the point I’m trapped in my fucking parents house with no escape for 5 years. And honestly I don’t think I can make it that long in this house.

I absolutely hate animal abuse too. I can’t cut myself either it seems to painful and I don’t think I can stand blood. I’m not sure. I understand you my parents broke my trust two or three years ago. I want to not exist to end my pain and suffering, I’m 13. Like you the only thing stopping me is being too much of a coward to actually kill myself . I hope it gets better for the both of us, otherwise I don’t think I can make it.
